name: io.github.funkyfunc/fearch
description: Respectful, corporate-safe, free web search and page reading for coding agents: honest identity, robots.txt, a self-identified browser tier, refusals as structured diagnoses, keyless official search.

packageArguments.name: --robots
packageArguments.description: default | strict | minimal | off — robots.txt groups that apply, or not consulted at all.

packageArguments.name: --browser
packageArguments.description: headless | headed | off — bundled headless Chromium, your installed Chrome in a window, or no browser tier.

packageArguments.name: --handoff
packageArguments.description: Hand challenges to the person in the browser window (implies --browser headed).

packageArguments.name: --engines
packageArguments.description: Engine result pages in preference order: google,bing,duckduckgo (default duckduckgo).

packageArguments.name: --exa
packageArguments.description: Add Exa's keyless hosted search as the fallback (queries are logged by Exa; off by default).

environmentVariables.name: FEARCH_UA_INFO_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL shown in the User-Agent (defaults to the project's bot-info page).

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: higher GitHub API limits and code search.
